Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică

Contract Duration: 1 Year, with the posibility to be extended
 Working Hours: Fulltime, Monday to Friday
 The Junior Onsite IT Services Partner will be responsible for providing comprehensive support for Schneider Electric workplace and infrastructure equipment. This role involves hands-on technical tasks, coordination with external vendors, and ensuring high levels of end-user satisfaction. The technician will perform a variety of services including hardware break and fix, warranty management, asset tracking, IMACD (Install, Move, Add, Change, De-Install), eyes and hand support, and escort services.
 What will you do?
Desk-side Support: Provide direct support to end-users for workplace equipment including desktops, laptops, tablets, smartphones, and other devices.
Hardware Break & Fix: Assist in diagnosing and repairing hardware issues, manage replacement of defective units, and ensure data restoration.
Warranty Management: Coordinate repairs with manufacturers and third-party maintenance suppliers, manage warranty claims, and handle logistics for defective units.
Asset Tracking: Maintain accurate records of equipment status, location, and user assignments in the asset management system.
IMACD Services: Perform installations, moves, additions, changes, and de-installations of workplace equipment, ensuring proper configuration and user acceptance.
Eyes and Hand Support: Execute technical tasks under the direction of remote administration teams, including equipment resets, installations, and troubleshooting.
Stock Management: Manage inventory levels, procure items, and ensure availability of spare accessories and consumables.
Onboarding: Assist new employees with IT asset delivery, setup, and training on Schneider Electric systems and tools.
Event Support: Provide technical support for special events, including setup and troubleshooting of audio/visual equipment.
 What skills and capabilities will make you successful?
Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field would be a plus
2-3 years of experience in IT Support, Service Desk, End-User Computing, or a similar technical support role.
Good knowledge of workplace and infrastructure equipment, including desktops, laptops, tablets, smartphones, printers, and peripheral devices.
Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues in a corporate environment.
Familiarity with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft 365 applications, and standard IT support tools.
Experience performing IMACD activities (Install, Move, Add, Change, De-Install) for end-user devices and workplace equipment.
Knowledge of asset management processes, inventory tracking, and hardware lifecycle management.
Experience coordinating with external vendors and handling warranty-related activities.
Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues independently while escalating complex cases when required.
Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accurate documentation practices.
Excellent communication skills and a customer-focused mindset when supporting end-users.
Strong understanding of security, compliance, and confidentiality requirements.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a local and global support team.
Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
